description: Out-of-Order CPU Design Space Exploration - Performance/Area Pareto Analysis

area.description: Silicon area score approximation for an OoO CPU core. Captures the cost of wide issue (width scales the register read/write ports and ROB ports), the ROB storage, and the register file storage.
area.formula: width * (2 * rob_size + num_int_regs + num_fp_regs) + 4 * width + 2 * rob_size + num_int_regs + num_fp_regs

ipc.description: Analytical IPC model for an OoO processor. The achievable IPC is the minimum of all applicable constraints. Each constraint represents a different hardware or workload limitation.

constraints.name: width
constraints.description: Pipeline fetch/decode/commit width limit - cannot process more instructions per cycle than the pipeline width

constraints.name: ilp
constraints.description: Intrinsic instruction-level parallelism of the workload - the theoretical maximum IPC achievable by an infinitely resourced machine

constraints.name: rob
constraints.description: ROB-limited throughput derived from Little's Law: throughput = occupancy / latency. The ROB limits how many instructions can be in-flight simultaneously.

constraints.name: int_regs
constraints.description: Integer register file pressure. Free physical registers = num_int_regs - arch_registers. Each integer instruction occupies a register for avg_int_reg_lifetime cycles, and frac_int of all instructions are integer type. NON-BINDING (treat as infinity) when frac_int == 0.

constraints.name: fp_regs
constraints.description: FP register file pressure. Analogous to integer register constraint but for floating-point registers. NON-BINDING (treat as infinity) when frac_fp == 0.

matmul.description: Dense matrix multiplication - FP compute bound with long FP register lifetimes

bfs.description: Breadth-first search on a graph - memory latency bound with irregular access patterns

sort.description: Comparison-based sorting - branch-heavy integer workload with moderate ILP

queens.description: N-Queens backtracking solver - recursive integer workload with long register lifetimes and deep speculation

stream.description: Streaming integer array processing - pure integer workload with no FP instructions and high ILP

validation.description: Little core - narrow pipeline with small ROB and register files
Big core - wide pipeline with large ROB and register files

schema.configurations_evaluated: Total number of configurations in the parameter space (integer). Should equal the product of the sizes of all parameter arrays.
schema.pareto_frontier: Array of non-dominated configurations in the area vs. geometric-mean-IPC tradeoff space, sorted by area ascending. Geometric mean IPC must be strictly increasing along the frontier. Each entry is an object with fields: width (int), rob_size (int), num_int_regs (int), num_fp_regs (int), area (int), geo_mean_ipc (float), per_workload_ipc (object mapping workload name to float IPC value).
schema.budget_optimal: Object keyed by area budget value as a string (e.g. '1200'). Each value is the configuration with the highest geometric mean IPC among all configurations whose area does not exceed the budget. Same fields as pareto_frontier entries. For ties in geo_mean_ipc, prefer the configuration with smaller area.
